commands.note: Only the latest sixteen final gates certify the frozen map. Development failures/source-change observations and every available raw native experiment remain separate; no historical runtime is recertified.

checks.example_types: pass; existing Node Vite config/mock server excluded
checks.installed_pinning: Current pinned flags, actual native starts/spacing, width change, preserved editor/caret/drafts, valid reorder, atomic prefix error, mixed native span, exact disposal and quiet late events in the same tar on all five Windows browsers.

blocks.merge: Adjacent scalar group keys span complete two-row records; each native merge stays inside a consecutive mounted segment.

method.timing: Rows and authored HTML prepared outside timing. Each operation includes two successive stable animation-frame geometry observations; fail after fifteen frames.
method.focus: One invalid draft editor remains pinned with its exact node and caret while a distant variable-height window renders.
method.paste: Flat/nested paste one thousand offscreen records; blocks paste one hundred. Each changes two fields in one atomic event; nested detail uses numeric Select values.
method.move: Move the last of five thousand stored rows before a stable row near the current window; one event, unchanged snapshot and pinned draft/caret. Includes settled DOM with a 100ms same-host Chromium median budget.

append.operation: After original operations and twenty scroll-cycle assertions, append 250 clean records in one event. Preserve every old snapshot/order, save changes, checks, focused node/draft/caret and scroll anchor. Dispose all 5,250 records under the original cleanup budget.

method.geometry: Every live checkpoint requires intersecting mounted data rows and different measured row heights; reveal verifies the complete requested record rectangle and forward scroll advances logical intersection. Blocks record native physical-row heights, record bounds and merge spans; twenty cycle windows record actual intersections.
method.cleanup: Exact authored markup/style after disposal, then observe zero mutations across late scroll and stable frames; this observes quiet work, not a direct cancelAnimationFrame call.
method.memory: Chromium CDP forces GC before DOM counters; twenty-cycle growth remains bounded by two viewport element counts and twenty listeners. After detaching the fixture, record native focus/selection retention, release it by focusing the existing external main and clearing document ranges, wait two frames, then require the stated pre-fixture cleanup budget. No JavaScript heap-retention claim.
method.budgets: Host-relative Chromium medians declared before measurement; other engines report samples without applying Chromium thresholds.

performance.limits: Unchanged same-host Chromium default fixtures/warmups/samples/budgets. Pin tests separately prove bounded observers/native measurements and record identity; no universal speed, heap or actual-token claim.

development_experiments.note: Available raw native geometry, CSSOM and wheel observations include failed/negative controls. They are development evidence outside the final source-gate certificate; overwritten/unavailable interim execution is not reconstructed.

review.baseline: Independent e0f3b96 recovery matched174 inputs,22 logs,16 latest final gates and every actual183-file package member. Historical runtime was not rerun or recertified.
review.source: Independent connected Ponytail source/callers/demo/consumer/document review. Narrow visible probes, completion after data/row hooks, atomic pin prefix and conditional literal/foreign style restoration are reviewed.
review.evidence: Independent review matches all fifty raw records, twelve manifests, twenty-seven available experiment files, actual archive bytes/individual sizes and sixty medians recomputed from 300 durations; original budgets, live checkpoints, scroll windows, append and quiet cleanup invariants pass.
review.scope: One GridColumn flag extends the existing owner. Private page wheel composition is outside package exports/files; no new framework source module, public type, handle or dependency.

limits: Only selected pin/wheel/reduced-detail outcomes are certified; shared rules/declarations/defaults, incoming statuses/wire formats, other parity, P0 and mandatory M13 remain required.

Physical-left/LTR ordinary untransformed native tables; mixed spans stay in flow and a prefix wider than its scrollport retains native clipping. Wheel recipe uses the dominant axis and native keyboard/touch behavior, not a general overscroll polyfill.

Actual macOS/iOS Safari is excluded. Manual assistive technology, personal acceptance and final fixed agent-task/token evaluation remain unverified. No publication, release tag, master/v1 change or feature omission.
